changeSet.sql: UPDATE shipment_rd rd SET courier_code = s.supplier_code, courier_name = TRIM(CONCAT(s.first_name, ' ', s.last_name)) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_id) target_id, supplier_id FROM delivery WHERE target_type = 'SHIPMENT' AND delivery_type = 'OUTBOUND' AND status <> 'CANCELED' ORDER BY target_id, created DESC) current_delivery JOIN suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = current_delivery.supplier_id WHERE CAST(rd.shipment_id AS VARCHAR(255)) = current_delivery.target_id
